anyOf.description: Advisory service preference. Fast or Economy may use ordinary Standard service; fallback never introduces Fast. Omission preserves native defaults. Explicit native serviceTier takes precedence.

requested.description: Advisory service preference. Fast or Economy may use ordinary Standard service; fallback never introduces Fast. Omission preserves native defaults. Explicit native serviceTier takes precedence.

submitted.description: Advisory service preference. Fast or Economy may use ordinary Standard service; fallback never introduces Fast. Omission preserves native defaults. Explicit native serviceTier takes precedence.

anyOf.description: User-supplied string that must contain visible content, not just whitespace.

submittedNative.description: User-supplied string that must contain visible content, not just whitespace.

reason.description: User-supplied string that must contain visible content, not just whitespace.

processing.description: Requested intent, submitted native control, and observed execution are independent facts. A submitted flag never proves observed service; mixed or missing session observations remain explicit.

nativeMode.description: User-supplied string that must contain visible content, not just whitespace.

debit.description: The route reports no actual cash or purchased-credit debit. Included service still admits the work, but its cash stays unknown instead of zero and is outside the finite cap; absence keeps proven ordinary inclusion as zero cash.

processingCostBasis.description: Mode-qualified billing evidence for an existing cost record. Authentication alone does not establish included premium service; credits, cash, and token valuation stay distinct.

cashKnowledge.description: Quality of incremental-cash cost evidence for an operation.

usageCost.description: Observed usage components. An amount of unknown meaning is not charged cash; separately proven included service can still establish exact zero incremental cash unless its route reports no actual debit.

items.description: Compact projection of existing attempt execution and amount evidence.

jobId.description: Daemon job id backing the run.

delegatedFromRunId.description: Claudexor Delegate parent run id; null for ordinary runs and native vendor subagents.

anyOf.description: Engine-owned Delegate requested/effective/used receipt; surfaces project it without parsing model output.

delegation.description: Durable Delegate requested/effective/used receipt projected from engine telemetry; null when legacy telemetry has no receipt.

continueFrom.description: Predecessor run this run continues (continueFrom); null for ordinary runs.

cause.description: Typed reason the previous process stopped: a vendor limit (next account eligible), the whole pool spent, a pinned account's limit, a transport death (crash, timeout, watchdog), a confirmed native tool permission refusal, context exhaustion, the wall-clock deadline, a cancel, a daemon/host restart, a model that asked for input, or another typed cause.

resetsAt.description: When the spent vendor window reopens, only from a vendor signal; never fabricated.

limitWindow.description: The vendor's own name for the spent window (e.g. five_hour, seven_day_opus), when known.

anyOf.description: window: the vendor named the spent window (a reset instant or a constraint id); unspecified: a typed limit without a window — a bare backoff frame is transport, not a limit.

limitEvidence.description: window: the vendor named the spent window (a reset instant or a constraint id); unspecified: a typed limit without a window — a bare backoff frame is transport, not a limit.

items.description: A continuity representation still available for a stopped run.

carriers.description: Continuity representations still available (NOT quota readiness; readiness is described by the limit facts).

limitCode.description: The typed vendor limit code that ended the work, when any.

session.description: The native session a continuation can resume, when one exists.

workspace.description: Where the stopped work's tree is: the live root, a retained envelope, or gone.

anyOf.description: Terminal facts of a stopped run that can be continued: cause, limit evidence, available carriers, the native session and the workspace.

resumable.description: Terminal facts of unfinished work that continueFrom can continue; null when the work finished or the run is not terminal.

tryIndex.description: Native try within the attempt; joins the receipt to its try.

carrier.description: Carrier of a continued try: native (the vendor's own session, same account), native_moved (the session file made visible in the next account's store, then resumed there), packet (a fresh session re-grounded by an evidence index), or fresh (nothing to carry — a replay of the original prompt).

workspace.description: Whether the continued try runs in the predecessor's execution root.

memory.description: Its own fact: a native resume carries the whole history (full); a packet re-brief is partial; a native resume that lost history (e.g. a rejected compacted item) is partial/unknown.

instructions.description: as_sent: the successor's instructions equal the predecessor's; vendor_snapshot: they differ, and the vendor may resend its recorded system prompt instead (claude records it on the first request).

reingestedTokens.description: Input + cache-creation tokens of the first resumed request, when known.

observedModel.description: THIS try's attested model (never borrowed from another try).

identityCheck.description: Whether the resumed vendor session was the one requested, judged at the earliest handshake (codex thread/resume before turn/start; claude system/init): matched, mismatch caught before the child could act, mismatch caught after it may have acted, or not applicable (no resume was requested, or a harness without the continuity capability answered with another session id, which is recorded as before).

inputDelivery.description: Whether the predecessor's last input (its turn prompt or an admitted steering message) is known to be in the vendor history: confirmed, uncertain (carried in the notice as a reference to reconcile, never replayed blindly), or not applicable.

sourceRetirement.description: After a native_moved carrier published the new holder: retired (the adapter removed the source copy) or not_confirmed (removal failed, possibly part-way). Absent = no move retired a source for this try.

items.description: Receipt of one continued try: carrier, cause, accounts, memory, model attestation.

continuity.description: One receipt per continued try (carrier, cause, accounts, memory, model), from the run's event log: projected on run detail (GET /runs/:id), omitted from list rows.

root.description: Absolute path of the kept working tree.

bytes.description: Disk use of the kept envelope (tree + scoped home); null when not measured.

cause.description: Why the run stopped, when recorded.

anyOf.description: An isolated envelope kept for continuation: continue it with continueFrom, or release it with the discard decision.

retainedEnvelope.description: Isolated envelope kept for continuation (disk use visible); null when none.

state.description: Control-plane run state = the run LIFECYCLE (D8): queued/running while live, then exactly one of succeeded / failed / cancelled / interrupted. Outcome quality (checks/review/delivery) is orthogonal — see outcomeFacts.

error.description: Error message, when the run failed.

scope.description: All text input items in one native turn; separate instructions are excluded.

reported_source.description: Redacted credential source the vendor's startup frame reported.

requestRefusal.description: Vendor-attested request refusal that stops retries and account rotation on its harness; input, executable and credential-source causes carry their own evidence.

packet_tokens.description: The packet with every optional file omitted: mandatory files, file manifest and metadata.

framing_tokens.description: The request outside the packet: instructions, user text, patch protocol and attachments.

output_allowance_tokens.description: Tokens kept free for the answer.

estimated_tokens.description: This file's share of packet_tokens: its packet entry with content and evidence.

rawContextShortfall.description: Typed sizes behind code raw_context_exceeds_window: the window, the request's parts and every mandatory file, so surfaces never read them from safeMessage.

exact.description: Always false: an inventory names files; it is not the exact change.

path.description: Top-relative changed path, exact within the length cap.

change.description: What happened to the path between the turn's base and the uncaptured tree.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the new blob (of the old blob for a deletion); null when Git could not size it.

items.description: One changed path of a non-exact capture inventory.

largest.description: The largest changed files, largest first.

inventory.description: Bounded non-exact inventory of the changed files behind a refused capture.

phase.description: Pipeline phase where the failure happened.

category.description: Typed failure category (validation, project, auth, harness, config, budget, policy, cancelled, internal, unknown). config_error is a settings/routing misconfiguration (e.g. quality routing with no comparable tier), corrected by changing configuration, not by re-auth or waiting for a harness.

anyOf.description: Machine-readable failure sub-code within a RunFailure category, including historical delegated-run failures and active access-profile refusals.

code.description: Machine-readable failure sub-code within the category; null when the category alone is sufficient. Surfaces choose remediation from this, never by parsing safeMessage.

harnessId.description: Harness involved in the failure, when known.

attemptId.description: Attempt involved in the failure, when known.

rawDetailRef.description: Artifact path holding the raw (redacted) failure detail.

logRefs.description: Log artifact paths relevant to the failure.

eventRefs.description: Event references relevant to the failure.

resetsAt.description: When the refused window reopens (a spent subscription quota window), or null when the failure has no such time. Callers schedule a retry off this field, never off safeMessage.

basis.description: owner_reserve: usage reached the saved headroom_threshold below 100% while the provider reports quota left; provider_window: the provider reports the window spent; provider_cooldown: a provider rate-limit cooldown is in force.

constraintId.description: The refusing quota window, when known.

threshold.description: The headroom_threshold the decision applied, when it applied one.

quotaRefusal.description: Present when quota admission refused the account (code subscription_window_exhausted): separates the owner's saved reserve from provider exhaustion. Absent on other failures and on records written before this field existed.

code.description: The vendor's own machine-readable failure code, verbatim; null when the vendor recorded an error without one.

message.description: The vendor's own words from the same record, verbatim (redacted); null when absent.

source.description: Evidence channel the code was read from (codex: `codex_rollout`). An open vocabulary: consumers display it, never branch on it.

anyOf.description: Vendor-typed failure evidence read from a vendor-owned machine-readable record, never parsed from prose.

vendorFailure.description: The vendor's own typed failure for the attempt this record speaks for, or null when no vendor-typed evidence exists (every harness without such a channel, and any unreadable record). Facts only: carries no remedy.

profileId.description: Account row the try ran on; null = the harness default route.

profileDisplayName.description: The row's display name at try time (redacted); null for the default route.

requestedModel.description: Model the try asked for; null = the harness default model.

tryIndex.description: Zero-based try index within the attempt.

observedAt.description: When the try's first error was observed.

phase.description: How far the try got: before a typed session start, after start but before agent progress, or after progress.

category.description: Typed failure category of the try; untyped errors are unknown_harness_error.

error.description: The try's own error text with its original wording and whitespace, redacted.

vendorFailure.description: The vendor's own typed failure for this try, when the adapter attached one.

items.description: Per-try account attribution of a failed execution try (diagnostic evidence only).

poolAttempts.description: Every failed execution try in order, each with its own account and error text; empty when no try failed (and for records written before this field existed).

anyOf.description: Typed failure record for a run: phase, category, evidence references, and suggested next actions.

failure.description: Typed failure record; null unless the run failed.

kind.description: Whether the run was anchored to a project.

context.description: Project context depth used for the run.

project.description: Project metadata projected onto a run summary.

executionRoot.description: Tree this run's file references resolve in: a delegated run's recorded execution.workspaceRoot, otherwise project.root; null without a project. The stable identity stays project.root.

mode.description: Canonical run mode: ask and plan are read-only, agent writes. Strategy controls are separate schema-owned fields, never modes.

strategy.description: Engine strategy flag on the mode (race width / attempt caps / until-clean / deep-scan / create); flags, not modes.

prompt.description: The user's prompt for the run.

routingGoal.description: Routing objective: pace expiring quota, choose the highest declared quality tier, or minimize incremental paid spend.

model.description: Scalar model requested for the run.

review.description: Resolved model-review intent; absent on historical runs that retain review-required semantics.

harness.description: Explicit reviewer harness id; repeated harness ids are allowed so one provider can review through multiple requested models.

model.description: Per-reviewer model hint, passed to that harness only.

effort.description: Per-reviewer effort hint, passed to that harness only.

credentialProfileId.description: Per-reviewer credential profile id; explicit pins are strict and never fall back.

processingPreference.description: Advisory service preference. Fast or Economy may use ordinary Standard service; fallback never introduces Fast. Omission preserves native defaults. Explicit native serviceTier takes precedence.

items.description: One reviewer of an explicit reviewer panel — a harness plus optional model, effort, and strict credentialProfileId. Compact entries are unpinned; structured JSON carries pins.

reviewerPanel.description: Explicit reviewer panel used for the run.

path.description: Glob approved by the operator/user for this run; consumed only by the auto-protected gate/test path policy, not by built-in critical-path gates.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for the approval.

items.description: Per-run typed operator approval allowing changes under an auto-protected gate/test path.

n.description: Race width, when the run was a race.

paidBudget.description: Explicit incremental-cash budget for the run.

spendUsd.description: Settled cash in USD; null when unknown.

spendEstimated.description: True when settled cash is estimated rather than exact.

inputTokens.description: Input tokens summed across all attempts; null when no harness reported them.

outputTokens.description: Output tokens summed across all attempts; null when no harness reported them.

cachedInputTokens.description: Cached input tokens summed across all attempts; null when no harness reported them.

inputTokenUsage.description: Normalized input measurement projected from run telemetry; absent on older runs.

outputConformance.description: Structured-output conformance receipt (passed/failed); null when the run had no outputSchema.

requested.description: Preferred auth route: subscription (native/OAuth session), api_key (a stored API key), or auto (engine picks subscription-first with policy fallback). A preference, not a secret.

anyOf.description: Auth mode a route runs under: a native local session, an API key, or unknown.

effective.description: Auth mode a route runs under: a native local session, an API key, or unknown.

anyOf.description: Concrete credential source used or probed by a harness.

source.description: Concrete credential source used or probed by a harness.

reason.description: Deterministic reason for the effective auth route: as_requested, native_first (auto, INV-061), no_native_session_fallback (auto downgraded to api_key), requested_route_unavailable (explicit preference contradicted), or undisclosed.

profileId.description: Credential profile the deciding attempt ran under; null = engine-default credentials.

modelMismatch.description: Requested-vs-observed model mismatch; null when none.

authRoute.description: Auth route receipt (requested/effective/source/reason + disclosing attempt), projected verbatim from telemetry; null when unavailable.

access.description: Access profile of the run: the effective profile when known, else the requested one (prefer requestedAccess/effectiveAccess).

effectiveAccess.description: Access profile actually enforced by the engine.

externalContextPolicy.description: Requested web policy for the run.

webMode.description: Web policy actually executed by the selected route.

mode.description: Requested external-context policy for the run.

effectiveMode.description: Policy the selected route actually executed (disclosed upgrades, e.g. cached to live).

attempted.description: Whether any web activity was attempted.

satisfied.description: Completed without a typed failure; retrieved content is not necessarily proven.

status.description: Observed web status; satisfied does not prove retrieved content was verified.

tool.description: Web tool that produced the evidence, when any.

target.description: Target (query/url) of the web activity as issued, when any.

errorSummary.description: Redacted error detail when web activity failed.

rawDetailRef.description: Artifact path holding the full evidence record.

available.description: False when the run predates the telemetry artifact; surfaces must render "telemetry unavailable".

webEvidence.description: Web evidence projected onto a run summary from the telemetry artifact.

items.description: Preflight resolution of one requested capability on one selected harness lane.

requestRequirements.description: Engine-computed requested/effective capability receipts for selected harness lanes.

toolPermissionPolicy.description: Tool allow/deny policy applied to the run.

outputReadyState.description: Whether a terminal run also has a loaded user-facing output artifact: pending (not yet), finalizing (being produced), ready (loaded), diagnostic (only diagnostic output).

toolWarningsTotal.description: Non-blocking tool warnings projected from the telemetry artifact.

kind.description: What the turn actually produced: a Git patch, directory files, an answer, a plan, a report, or nothing.

diffStat.description: Diff statistics; null unless a patch exists.

blockers.description: Count of accepted blocking review findings.

adopted.description: True when the live in-place tree was mutated this turn (regardless of review); null when unknown.

applyState.description: Honest application state: not_applied (delivery pending), applied, applied_review_blocked, reverted, or discarded (remaining copied output deliberately not applied).

preTurnSha.description: Tree SHA before this turn mutated the in-place tree (revert restore target).

postTurnSha.description: Tree SHA right after this turn's mutation; revert refuses if the working tree has diverged from this since.

revertable.description: Revert metadata is available so a Revert affordance may be offered; not a live-safe guarantee — the server re-checks tree divergence at revert time.

result.description: Honest terminal outcome of a run (what the turn actually did), projected from the work product and answer artifacts.

noChanges.description: True when the run finished without changing any files (the ex no_op fact).

checks.description: Deterministic checks axis: configured project checks passed, failed, or none are configured (a named state, never a stand-in for review results).

review.description: Review axis: approved (clean cross-family verified review), blocked (open accepted findings), or not_run.

review_requested.description: Frozen model-review intent. False permits an honestly unreviewed result; absent historical records retain the review requirement.

anyOf.description: Typed reason qualifying a non-clean terminal; null on a clean success.

reason.description: Typed reason qualifying a non-clean terminal; null on a clean success.

state.description: Folded work state: the WorkReport state, or unverified when no valid report was obtained (transport unsupported / lane gated, or an instructed footer missing or broken).

source.description: Provenance of a WorkReport: constrained (native schema transport), validated (instructed terminal metadata), or absent (no transport could carry one — a disclosed absence, not a failure).

kind.description: Category of a missing input a needs_input/incomplete report lists: a file, additional context, a credential, a permission, a human decision, or an external dependency.

locator.description: Concrete pointer to the missing thing (path/url/name); null when unnameable.

description.description: Human-readable description of what is needed and why.

items.description: One blocking input a needs_input/incomplete WorkReport lists.

required_inputs.description: Carried through from a needs_input/incomplete WorkReport for honest disclosure.

unverified_reason.description: Present only with state unverified on a validated (instructed footer) source: the disclosed cause of the missing report.

work_state.description: D-16 model-attested work outcome, orthogonal to lifecycle; a needs_input/incomplete state vetoes applyability and exit 0. Absent on runs with no work_report transport.

anyOf.description: Independent terminal outcome axes of a run (D8/D18).

outcomeFacts.description: D8 terminal outcome axes (checks/review/reason/noChanges) projected from decision.facts or derived from the failure; null while non-terminal.

waitingOnUser.description: True while at least one interactive question awaits answer, timeout, run-terminal, or interruption release.

settled.description: Every census source succeeded and no known member survived or stayed unreadable. Unreadable discovery candidates are not members; they limit completeness separately.

completeness.description: Whether a settled reap proves the scope empty (not on macOS for background system binaries, not on Windows, not after a census failure, not when the single settlement deadline expired — then settled is false and the run's final/process_scope.yaml carries incomplete=true with completeness_reason naming the deadline).

survivors.description: Members still alive when the bounded ladder ended.

unreadable.description: Known members whose identity or membership could not be read.

anyOf.description: Compact process-scope outcome of a terminal run (full artifact: final/process_scope.yaml).

processScope.description: Compact process-scope outcome from final/process_scope.yaml (settled, coverage, completeness, survivors, unreadable, census). Always present in this engine's responses: null means unknown (the run is live, or the record is missing, unreadable or invalid), never clean. Engines that predate the field omit the key, which is equally unknown.

observedModel.description: Model the harness stream actually reported.

harnessId.description: Harness that ran the final attempt.

verified.description: True only when an observed model was actually reported by the harness stream — never inferred from the request.

anyOf.description: Run-level route evidence projected from telemetry (requested vs observed model).

route.description: Route evidence from telemetry; null when no telemetry exists (legacy runs).

paid_fallback.description: When a route with incremental paid spend may be used.

dropped.description: Ids removed by paid_fallback or cooldown before ranking.

reason.description: Typed decisive reason the pool ranked the way it did (QA-034).

billing_knowledge.description: Effective billing knowledge used to rank it.

incremental_cost_usd.description: Known incremental cash cost, when any; null when unknown.

eligible.description: Whether the candidate survived paid_fallback/cooldown filtering.

items.description: Per-candidate billing/cost tuple in the routing rationale (QA-034).

anyOf.description: Typed routing rationale recorded once at pool ordering (QA-034).

routingRationale.description: Typed routing rationale (QA-034) projected from telemetry; null when no ranking was computed or on legacy runs.

estimated_request_tokens.description: Estimated tokens of the whole rendered request (chars/4, plus a fixed figure per image); never a tokenizer count.

model.description: Model whose catalog row was consulted; null when the producer reported none.

framing_tokens.description: Estimated tokens of the request outside this packet; null when unmeasured.

selection_limit_tokens.description: Limit the optional selection honoured: the packet's share of the window, or the assumed ceiling on file contents.

omitted_for_budget.description: Optional files left out to honour selection_limit_tokens (listed in omissions).

mandatory_paths.description: Project mandatory files, each delivered complete in readable_files.

budget.description: Sizing evidence for a raw context packet; disclosed, never a tokenizer count.

anyOf.description: Estimated size of one raw-api request as prepared just before its POST, and the budget its packet honoured; not proof the provider received it.

rawContext.description: Size of the raw-api request the final attempt last prepared, as receipted just before its POST (#147); null otherwise.

program.description: Executable invoked directly without an implicit shell.

args.description: Exact argv passed to the executable.

cwd.description: Optional project-relative working directory for the command.

envAllowlist.description: Non-secret parent environment names explicitly forwarded to the command.

items.description: Canonical deterministic command invocation; no implicit shell parsing.

summary.description: Run summary row served by GET /runs and embedded in run detail: state, routing, budget, policies, and honest outcome.

predecessorResult.description: Existing addressed run-detail/result path; no duplicate result store.

code.description: Machine-readable refusal code carried from the throwing gate; null when the failure had no typed code.

retryable.description: True when retry can replay this turn (a job was recorded before the failure); false when no job exists to replay.

required_actions.description: Bounded user actions that may make an exact retry succeed.

context.description: Bounded typed recovery context; never arbitrary provider or environment output.

problem.description: Typed, sanitized problem for a thread turn that could not start.

anyOf.description: Stable hold. Editing, observation and readiness restoration never rearm it; inspect the predecessor result and clear before an ordinary continuation.

hold.description: Stable hold. Editing, observation and readiness restoration never rearm it; inspect the predecessor result and clear before an ordinary continuation.

anyOf.description: Compact addressed draft state, with exact predecessor result and successor handles. A terminal predecessor does not imply the draft has resolved.

deferredMessage.description: Compact addressed draft state, with exact predecessor result and successor handles. A terminal predecessor does not imply the draft has resolved.

children.description: Direct Claudexor Delegate child runs, projected from persisted delegatedFromRunId lineage for reload-safe flat rows.

schema_version.description: Schema version of the artifact; bumped on breaking ABI changes.

present.description: Whether the canonical primary deliverable exists.

kind.description: Kind of canonical primary deliverable; null when none exists.

path.description: Run-relative path of the canonical primary deliverable; null when absent.

producer_attempt_id.description: Attempt that produced the deliverable, when known.

deliverable.description: Canonical primary-output presence and identity for a terminal run.

state.description: Terminal output readiness decided by the last valid output.ready receipt.

kind.description: Presentation kind of the terminal primary artifact.

path.description: Normalized run-relative path of the terminal primary artifact.

anyOf.description: Primary user-facing artifact selected once during terminal preparation.

primary.description: Selected terminal primary artifact, or null when the receipt announces readiness without a primary deliverable.

presentation.description: Immutable terminal output state and primary artifact. Absent only on legacy RunFacts receipts.

planners.description: Number of participants whose canonical role is planner.

attempt_id.description: Attempt id when the participant owns an orchestrator attempt; null for reviewer-panel members.

harness_id.description: Harness that served this participant role.

role.description: Canonical role of one participant in the terminal run graph.

deliverable_present.description: Whether this participant produced the deliverable its role requested.

anyOf.description: Terminal outcome recorded for one run participant.

status.description: Participant outcome when recorded; null for artifact-only reviewer membership.

items.description: One role-labelled participant in the terminal run graph.

participants.description: Terminal participant graph plus its planner-lane count.

configured.description: Whether the frozen task configured deterministic gates.

executed.description: Whether the terminal attempt executed the gate set.

state.description: Terminal state of the configured deterministic gate set.

receipt_attempt_id.description: Attempt whose gate receipt decides this projection; null when no gates executed.

gates.description: Canonical gate configuration and terminal receipt projection.

blocker_ids.description: Stable ids of accepted evidence-backed blocking findings.

review.description: Canonical terminal review verdict and blocking-finding identity.

eligible.description: True when the apply gate would accept this run's patch right now.

state.description: The gate's apply-eligibility classification (e.g. needs_review | not_verified | no_changes | ok) when known.

reason.description: The gate's refusal text when not eligible (null when eligible).

requiredAction.description: Honest guidance for what actually unblocks apply (typed operator decision, add gates, re-run, or nothing to apply).

anyOf.description: Derived apply-gate verdict for a run's WorkProduct (single producer in the delivery gate).

eligibility.description: Delivery-gate eligibility at terminalization; null when nothing is applyable.

operator_decision_present.description: Whether a valid operator decision was present when the receipt was finalized.

apply.description: Terminal apply eligibility and operator-decision state.

id.description: Stable machine id for a required operator action on a blocked terminal run.

detail.description: Human-readable guidance for this action (English-only, INV-141).

items.description: One typed required operator action derived from a run's terminal outcome facts.

required_actions.description: Typed actions required to unblock this terminal outcome.

generated_at.description: When this immutable terminal receipt was finalized.

anyOf.description: Validated immutable terminal facts for one run.

runFacts.description: Validated terminal RunFacts receipt; null while active or unavailable.

outcomeBanner.description: Server-owned outcome headline (status-projection.outcomeBanner); null while the run is not terminal.

lastSeq.description: Highest event seq included in this snapshot; clients subscribe to the event stream from this cursor (snapshot-then-subscribe, no gaps, no dupes).

path.description: Artifact path relative to the run directory.

kind.description: Whether the artifact is a file or a directory.

bytes.description: Size in bytes; absent for directories.

mime.description: MIME type derived from the extension; absent for directories.

items.description: One artifact in the run's artifact tree.

artifacts.description: Artifacts recorded in the run tree.

kind.description: What kind of output this is: answer, report, plan, summary, patch, diagnostic, or structured_output (schema-conformant final/output.json).

bytes.description: Size of the output in bytes.

truncated.description: True when text is a bounded inline preview of the full artifact.

anyOf.description: The run's primary user-facing output artifact.

primaryOutput.description: The run's primary user-facing output; null while pending.

messageId.description: Live-message id on message.* receipt rows and on the adapter's live_input_delivered status row, when any.

outcome.description: Typed live-message outcome on message.* rows (delivered | accepted | rejected | not_active | unsupported | delivery_unknown); `delivered` on the adapter's consumption status row; null elsewhere.

detail.description: Human-readable event detail. For typed harness text, the complete text as journaled, with original whitespace; title may be abbreviated.

textKind.description: Normalized harness text category; null for non-text or legacy rows. Read text from detail, not the abbreviated title.

textDelta.description: True only for adapter-declared text fragments. Consecutive deltas of the same textKind and attempt may be concatenated verbatim; complete messages and other events remain separate.

speechKey.description: Adapter-issued key of the observed text block this row belongs to (the harness event's speech.key); compare by equality only. Null when no block lifecycle was exactly observed; such rows stay separate.

anyOf.description: fragment: a verbatim streamed piece of the keyed text block; complete: the harness's complete text of that block (at most once per key); abandoned: the harness stated the block will never be completed (partial fragments stay as emitted).

speechOp.description: The harness event's speech.op on keyed rows; null otherwise.

textFinal.description: True only on the harness's typed final-answer text row (the harness event's final flag). It carries a speech key only when the adapter proved the link; otherwise it is a separate terminal result.

target.description: Tool target for tool events, bounded, as the agent issued it.

errorSummary.description: Error detail: a failed tool's own output, unmasked; for an error event, its masked diagnostic.

ignoredSettings.description: Unsupported per-harness knobs the route could not honor (INV-105), disclosed on harness.started; empty when nothing was dropped (QA-070).

rawRef.description: Reference to the raw underlying event/artifact.

items.description: One projected timeline row of a run for display.

cashKnowledge.description: Cash certainty from the ledger; explicit unknown keeps spendUsd null independently of valuation.

paidBudget.description: Incremental-cash budget: explicitly unlimited or a finite non-negative USD cap.

spendUsd.description: CASH spend so far in USD; null when unknown.

controllableSpendUsd.description: Cash governed by the finite cap: settled amounts on routes Claudexor controls; null when that cash is unknown. spendUsd can still be null when an included subscription reports no actual debit.

valuationUsd.description: Subscription valuation in USD (separate from billed cash); null when unknown — never a fabricated $0 (QA-023c).

valuationKnowledge.description: Confidence of valuationUsd: 'estimated' when token-derived, 'unknown' when no usage was reported (valuationUsd is then null), 'exact' when natively priced.

remainingUsd.description: Remaining finite cap after controllableSpendUsd; null when no cap or unknown.

estimated.description: True when settled cash is estimated rather than exact; subscription valuation confidence is reported separately.

source.description: Where the snapshot came from: the decision record, live events, settings, or unknown.

evidence.description: Integrity of the canonical events this spend fallback read: 'incomplete' when malformed/non-object event lines were skipped, 'unavailable' when the events file was unreadable, else 'complete'. A non-complete value means the projected spend may disagree with disk truth.

budget.description: Budget snapshot for a run: cap, spend, and provenance.

finalSummary.description: Final summary text; null when the run has none.

winner.description: Winning attempt/candidate id; null when nothing won.

why_not_others.description: Per-candidate reasons the others lost, keyed by candidate id.

ranking_policy_version.description: Version of the ranking axis registry the scorecard was produced under.

score_axes.description: Every compared ranking axis key, in precedence (best-first) order.

attempt_id.description: Candidate attempt id (stable key; labels may localize).

label.description: Anonymized candidate label shown to the arbiter.

axes.description: Formatted value for every ranking axis, keyed by axis key.

ranking_scorecard.description: Per-candidate full ranking scorecard, in final ranking order.

key.description: The first ranking axis that separated winner from runner-up.

winner_value.description: The winner's formatted value on the decisive axis.

runner_up_value.description: The runner-up's formatted value on the decisive axis.

decisive_axis.description: The axis that actually decided the winner vs the runner-up; null on an exact tie (route order decided, disclosed in final_checks).

accepted_risks.description: Risks explicitly accepted in the decision.

final_checks.description: Final checks performed before the decision.

evidence_facts.description: Evidence facts the decision rests on.

spend_usd.description: Total settled spend in USD; null when unknown.

estimated.description: True when settled cash is estimated rather than exact.

cash_usd.description: Settled cash spend in USD (0 on proven included routes); null when unknown, including an included subscription that reports no actual debit.

controllable_cash_usd.description: Cash governed by the finite cap: settled amounts on routes Claudexor controls; null when that cash is unknown. spend_usd and cash_usd stay null when an included subscription reports no actual debit. Absent on legacy decisions.

valuation_usd.description: Settled subscription-equivalent valuation in USD (includes the reviewer panel); null when unknown.

valuation_knowledge.description: Certainty of valuation_usd, independent from the settled-cash estimated flag. Absent only on legacy decisions.

budget_summary.description: Settled spend for the run; estimates are disclosed, never presented as exact.

apply_recommendation.description: Recommended next action for the run's work product: apply it, inspect first, continue working, or get human review.

verification_basis.description: Verification evidence: none, deterministic_checks, cross_family_review (clean and verified), or both. An intentionally unreviewed result can be applicable without verification evidence.

base_manifest_sha256.description: Exact directory manifest verified; not a Git commit identifier.

attempted.description: Whether the final verify was attempted.

base_sha.description: Base SHA the verify tree was created from (the winner envelope's base).

applied_cleanly.description: Whether the patch applied cleanly onto the fresh tree; null when not attempted.

gates_passed.description: Whether the re-run deterministic gates passed; null when not attempted.

duration_ms.description: How long the verify took, in milliseconds.

reason.description: Typed reason when attempted=false (e.g. no_patch, no_base_sha) or a failure detail.

anyOf.description: FinalVerifier record: the winner's patch was applied onto a fresh worktree at the candidate's own base SHA and the deterministic gates were re-run there; no model involvement.

final_verify.description: Final verify record; present only for write runs with a patch (or a recorded reason why the verifier did not run).

anyOf.description: The arbitration decision for a run: winner, outcome axes, reasons, spend, and the verification that backs applyability.

decision.description: The arbitration decision; null before arbitration.

operatorDecision.description: Persisted operator unblock decision (accept_risk/override), hash-bound; null when none was made.

kind.description: Kind of work product: Git patch, new repository, report, or complete directory file manifest with retained bytes.

source_task_id.description: Task the work product came from.

producer_attempt_id.description: Attempt that produced it, when known.

files.description: Kind-specific file payload, e.g. artifact name to path (validated loosely here; specialized per kind by callers).

anyOf.description: The deliverable a run produced, referenced by apply/delivery verbs; files uses files.manifest and meta.manifest_sha256.

workProduct.description: The run's work product; null when none was produced.

state.description: Derived plan readiness: ready (block parsed, zero open questions), needs_answers (open questions remain), unverified (no parseable block — the planner ignored the format).

anyOf.description: Server-derived readiness of a plan run (one derivation owner; D17).

planReadiness.description: Derived readiness of a plan run; null for non-plan runs.

id.description: Stable question id within the plan revision.

kind.description: Question kind: pick exactly one, pick one or more, or free text.

id.description: Stable option id within the question.

label.description: Option label shown to the user.

items.description: One selectable option of a plan question.

options.description: Options for single/multi questions; empty for free text.

allow_text.description: True when free text is accepted as a complete answer, including as an alternative to single/multi options.

items.description: One open question surfaced by a plan revision.

planQuestions.description: Open questions of a plan run (projected from final/questions.json); empty otherwise.

requested.description: Requested member count (n; at least 2, up to the configured Council cap).

drafted.description: Members with contract-accepted drafts; excludes retained unverified inputs and is not a work-completion or verification count.

degraded.description: True when fewer contract-accepted drafts than requested, including any retained unverified contribution; failures remain disclosed per member.

mergedBy.description: Harness that produced the unified plan (the primary); null if the merge failed.

harnessId.description: Harness that drafted (or merged) this member's plan.

role.description: primary = the merger that synthesizes the unified plan; member = draft only.

status.description: Draft outcome: drafted = contract-accepted input; merged = accepted draft and successful merge; failed stays failed even when its unverified text helped the merger.

error.description: First redacted draft error; null unless the member failed.

items.description: One council member's role and draft/merge outcome.

anyOf.description: Council membership + merge disclosure for a --council plan run.

council.description: Council membership + merge disclosure; null for solo plans and non-plan runs.

applyEligibility.description: Derived apply-gate verdict (single producer: the delivery gate); null when the run has no patch artifact.

severity.description: Reviewer-assigned severity of a finding: BLOCK and FIX_FIRST can block convergence when accepted with evidence, WARN/NIT are advisory, OUT_OF_SCOPE and INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE are triage verdicts, NEEDS_HUMAN escalates to a human decision.

category.description: Subject-matter category of a review finding.

linked_acceptance_criteria.description: Ids of acceptance criteria this finding relates to.

lines.description: Line range in the file (e.g. "10-42"); null when the whole file is cited.

items.description: File citation supporting a finding.

command.description: Command whose output supports the finding.

items.description: Command citation supporting a finding.

commands.description: Commands whose output supports the finding.

evidence.description: Evidence backing a finding; a finding without evidence cannot block.

proposed_fix.description: Reviewer-proposed fix; null when none was offered.

requested_model.description: Model requested for the reviewer route.

requested_effort.description: Reasoning effort requested for the reviewer route.

credential_profile_id.description: Credential profile requested/effective for the reviewer route; absent = account pool/default.

observed_credential_profile_id.description: Credential profile actually reported by the reviewer route; absent when undisclosed.

observed_model.description: Model the harness actually reported using.

route_proof_status.description: How strongly the executed route is proven: verified (observed evidence matches the request), accepted_model_arg (the requested model arg was accepted without stream evidence), unverified, or same_model_fallback (a fallback landed on the same model).

reviewer.description: Who reviewed: the harness/model route and its verification status.

status.description: Lifecycle status of a finding, from proposed through accepted/rebutted/fixed to terminal triage states (accepted_risk, duplicate, stale, out_of_scope, insufficient_evidence).

revalidation_note.description: Note recorded when the finding was revalidated against a changed tree.

items.description: One evidence-backed review finding produced by a reviewer harness.

reviewFindings.description: Review findings recorded for the run.

attemptId.description: Attempt the interaction was raised in, when known.

sourceTool.description: Native tool that raised the request.

header.description: Short chip/header text some harnesses attach to a question.

label.description: Option label shown to the user.

description.description: Optional longer explanation of the option.

items.description: One multiple-choice option of an interactive question.

options.description: Selectable options; empty for free-text-only questions.

multi_select.description: Whether multiple options may be selected.

items.description: One question of an interactive user-input request.

timeoutAt.description: When the interaction times out into a benign decline; null = no timeout.

items.description: A live interactive question awaiting the user's answer (snapshot projection).

costUsd.description: Spend attributed to the candidate, in USD.

costEstimated.description: True when the cost is token-derived rather than natively reported.

errored.description: True when the candidate's attempt errored.

errorReason.description: First redacted attempt error; null when the candidate did not error.

gatesPassed.description: Number of deterministic gates that passed.

gatesTotal.description: Total deterministic gates run for the candidate.

blockers.description: Count of accepted blocking review findings.

reviewVerified.description: Whether the candidate's review route was verified.

finalReviewClean.description: Whether the final review was clean; null when no final review ran.

diffstat.description: Diff statistics of the candidate's patch; null when there is no patch.

rankingAxes.description: This candidate's ranking-scorecard axis values (from decision.ranking_scorecard); null when no arbitration ran.

proven.description: Whether a historical outer boundary was proven by a named mechanism, digest, and denied path; false for current native-access attempts.

mechanism.description: Opaque label of the enforcing mechanism; null when no boundary was applied.

verifiedDeniedPath.description: Path proven unreadable under the applied policy before the harness was spawned.

unavailableReason.description: Why no additional outer boundary was applied; current delegated attempts carry the schema-owned deliberate-absence reason.

anyOf.description: Historical outer-boundary proof for one attempt, or the deliberate reason current native-access execution applied none.

confinement.description: Historical outer-boundary evidence or current deliberate-absence evidence; null when the attempt has neither.

items.description: Per-candidate evidence card for a race run, projected from attempt, review, and decision artifacts.

candidates.description: Per-candidate evidence cards for every envelope-producing mode; empty only when no attempt artifacts exist.

items.description: Plan items, last-wins.

evidence.description: Integrity of the canonical events this checklist was projected from: 'incomplete'/'unavailable' warns that a plan.progress event may have been lost to a malformed or unreadable events file, so the checklist may be stale or empty; 'complete' otherwise.

planProgress.description: Live plan checklist from the last plan.progress event; null when the run never emitted one AND its canonical events were fully readable. Non-null with empty items + non-complete evidence discloses that a plan event may have been dropped.

failure.description: Typed failure info; null unless the run failed.

requiredActions.description: Stable-id required operator actions for a succeeded-but-blocked run (GH #29); empty for clean/decided/failed runs.

ControlRunDetail.description: Full run detail snapshot served by GET /runs/:id: summary, artifacts, timeline, decision, findings, and progress.
